title: Notice of unpaid debt
paragraphs: To the new owner of the herb shop.
Your parent signed a loan with this guild. Your parent left on an expedition and did not return. By town law, the shop and its debt now pass to you.
The balance is {DEBT_START} gold. Interest of {DEBT_INTEREST_RATE%} is added to it at the end of each month.
Pay at least {DEBT_MIN_PAYMENT} gold at each month end. A short payment adds a late fee of {HIDDEN_FEE_LATE} gold. The guild does not give more time.
In two months, a clerk will come to read your books. Keep them in order.
_doc: Opening letter. Tone: cold and strict (user decision 8 Nov 2026). {KEY} shows a BalanceConfig number, {KEY%} shows it as a percent.
